about: Soft rules for place_layout.py: the search's size, the cost terms' weights and bands, groups, the camera pocket and the recovery ladder. Every value is a starting value from published furniture-layout work (interior-design guideline cost terms; access and wall-prior terms; reachability padding) or derived from the scene tool's framing rule, and none has been measured on built rooms yet. Hard rules about kinds of room and piece stay in room_kinds.json.

window_dressing.about: drapes hung at every window after the layout (the period kit's): their full width and depth stand on the floor; nothing stands in the side columns beyond the window, and no tall piece before the window itself. width 0 turns it off.

camera.about: A camera pocket: free floor in front of a face at a named place. From the scene tool's speaker rule (read, not imported): a speaker's head within 45 degrees of the camera; a talk face at least 0.10 of the frame height in a medium and 0.18 in a close; a 36 mm wide sensor, 20 mm high at 1152x640; lenses 28 to 100 mm. With a face about 0.24 m high the face size sets only a far limit (3.4 m at 28 mm for a medium, 1.9 m for a close; further with a longer lens), so the near limit is what a room can fail: the lens needs room to hold chest-up (medium) or head-and-shoulders (close) at 28 mm.

picture.about: Pieces a room takes from its concept picture that the text does not name (ids c<n>, place_build.with_concept). They are the room's dressing: each stands only where it fits and keeps off the floor the plan's people need; one that cannot is refused, never the reason a room fails. One the picture shows several of stands several times (one mesh, one record), in a row along the room's long side. One the picture's depth did not stand on the floor is not floor furniture. One that is the same thing as a piece of the spec is that piece.

fire.about: A fire piece (a piece of a floor kind that burns: gives_light) stands back to a wall, front into the room, as near where its picture has it as the walls allow; what the spec puts beside or by it (companion_rels) stands on the wall beside it. A piece a standing person works at (top within work_top_m) that the spec relates to the fire, or the plan's own work piece in a room with one fire, stands out on the floor before it: work_front_m from the fire's front to its own, at most work_side_m off the fire's middle, with clear floor work_clear_m wide on at least work_clear_sides of its sides. The relaxed numbers are tried only when no strict spot fits.
